title: Match capitals: Eastern Europe
intro: Match each country in Eastern Europe with its capital city.

pairs.explain: Sofia is the capital of Bulgaria.
Minsk is the capital of Belarus.
Prague is the capital of Czechia.
Chișinău is the capital of Republic of Moldova.
Warsaw is the capital of Poland.
Bucharest is the capital of Romania.
Moscow is the capital of Russian Federation.
Kyiv is the capital of Ukraine.
